User (user raid experience 2026-09-27): "Mage should not dispell remedy. If it does maybe thats why it gets over. If not stop dps at 50%". Round-1 check (kills 521c17, 6bf522): no Remedy was removed during the 30% hold. Maloriak's health samples show one full Remedy (250,000, 25,000/s for 10 s) at 94-104 s inside each hold (holds 79.5-105.2 s and 82.5-114.6 s). The only removal was the Mage's Spellsteal at about 46 s (stolen Remedy ticked on the Mage 46-55 s), before the hold. No Purge, Tranquilizing Shot or offensive Dispel Magic submission or rejection appears (Disc Priest Dispel Magic is ally-only). The plan already assigns no dispeller while the switch holds (tested). So AddSwitchHealthPct moved 30 -> 50; the rest of the tactic is unchanged. Budget: 50%->25% is 4.94M; Blood DK 23-31k minus Remedy's 10.4k average gives about 235 s or more (about 130 s even if the 15-17k DoT/proc tails continued) against a hold of about two minutes.

patch_requests.patch:
In test_a_no_reference_spec_cannot_qualify_on_the_wowsims_fallback, replace
    monkeypatch.setattr(scoreboard_core, "fallback_targets",
                        lambda root, target: {"feral_druid_tank": 9000.0, "fire_mage": 30000.0})
    references = reference_targets(ROOT, target)
with
    monkeypatch.setattr(scoreboard_core, "fallback_targets",
                        lambda root, target: {"feral_druid_tank": 9000.0, "fire_mage": 30000.0})
    # Round 2 matched fire_mage to WCL; drop that match so the fallback path is still exercised.
    real_spec_targets = scoreboard_core.spec_targets
    monkeypatch.setattr(scoreboard_core, "spec_targets",
                        lambda root, target: {spec: dps for spec, dps in real_spec_targets(root, target).items()
                                              if spec != "fire_mage"})
    references = reference_targets(ROOT, target)
(verified in a scratch run: the patched body passes against the round-2 Maloriak target).

risks: Main-tank sphere drag (phase two, melee damage dealers alive, boss on the tank, no Magma Jets cast): the tank walks 12 yd away from spheres that block every melee ring point; the boss frame turns, so the ranged fan re-seats and Magma Jets aim along the new facing. The destination is checked against room bounds, hazard clearances, a sphere at the path midpoint and the cauldron radius, not against the full native path.

Off-tank pull post: an add within 12 yd of Maloriak is taunted from a post 15 yd out; this assumes the taunt reaches (Growl/Dark Command/Hand of Reckoning/Taunt 30 yd; the dispatch's TryCastCombatSpell revalidates range). With the taunt on cooldown the Feral waits at the post and the add stays where it is. Applies in both phases.

Outer 5-yd melee ring: melee fight from 5 yd (r01 swings landed up to 6.5-6.9 yd) when the 3.5-yd ring is blocked; the fallback point passes the full formation clearance (hazards and the cauldron line of sight, FormationPointClear) after the GPT-6 Astra P2 review; the hold test (MeleeRingBlocked) stays hazards-only, so the cauldron never holds melee offense.

Native 10N only: Arcane Storm 14.3 s after engage (an uninterrupted channel delays the first cauldron visit, as in the WCL kills); phase-two Remedy 19.4 s after Unstable Mix then every 24 s (heals 250k per cast if not removed; the dispel roster already covers phase two). boss_maloriak.cpp is now 952 lines (limit 1,000).
Party WCL median (non-gating) moves to 152,038 because the six new kills' raid_dps join the median.
Native script and dispatch TU passed -fsyntax-only with the build's compile flags; no build was run.

50% hold: every damage dealer but the Blood DK leaves the boss from about 40 s until the chambers are empty (about 150-165 s by the WCL release cadence), idles between releases, and holds offensive cooldowns, potions and raid haste until phase two. Expect lower encounter-window DPS for every non-tank until measured; the 180 s cap (AddSwitchCapMs) still bounds the hold.

The new and changed strategy headers are included only by the Maloriak dispatch (Encounters/Maloriak); boss_maloriak.cpp changes are gated by IsTenNormal() and touch only Maloriak's AI. The 50% add-switch threshold is a Maloriak constant (BotMaloriakDuties.h). No shared runtime, class, harness or SQL change. The raid target change moves only fire_mage and assassination_rogue targets (the added references carry only those players in actor_dps) plus the non-gating party median. Magmaw, Stonecore, calibration and the other BWD shards are unaffected.
